name: Teardrop Floater
description: Attack the lane, then lift a soft, high-arcing one-hander over the outstretched arms of the big man before you reach the rim.
game: NBA Finals Game 2, Spurs vs. Heat

name: Step-Back Three
description: Sell a dribble move, then plant and push backward off one foot to create space and launch a high-arcing three.

name: Up-and-Under Reverse Layup
description: Drive baseline, go up and under the rim past the shot blocker, and finish with the opposite hand on the far side of the basket.

name: Hurdle Dunk
description: Catch the lob in stride, then leap clean over the defender in your path and throw it down with authority.

name: Backdoor Cut Layup
description: Cut behind your defender, catch a lead pass in stride, and lay it in.

name: Finger Roll
description: Drive to the rim, extend your hand palm up, and roll the ball off your fingertips.
game: 2015 NBA Finals Game 2, Cavaliers at Warriors

name: Straight-Line Drive
description: Drive straight to the basket, gather in stride, and finish with a layup.

name: Transition Layup
description: Push the ball up the floor and finish at the rim in stride.

name: Catch-and-Shoot Three
description: Set your feet behind the arc, catch a pass, and shoot in one motion.

name: Midrange Bank Shot
description: Set up on the wing inside the arc and aim your jumper at the upper near corner of the backboard square.

name: Running Push Floater
description: Take a short drive into the paint and release a soft one-handed push shot while moving forward.

name: Corner Retreat Three
description: Receive the pass inside the corner, step back until both feet clear the line, and fire.
game: 2013 NBA Finals Game 6, Spurs at Heat

name: Transition Pull-Up Three
description: Advance the ball in transition, stop behind the arc, and rise into a pull-up before the defense sets.
game: 2017 NBA Finals Game 3, Warriors at Cavaliers

name: Behind-the-Back Pass Fake
description: Sweep the ball behind your hip as if passing, keep it in your hand, then bring it forward for the layup.
game: 2012 Eastern Conference Finals Game 3, Heat at Celtics

name: Eurostep Layup
description: Gather the ball, take one long step to draw the defender, then step across in the opposite direction for the finish.

name: Lane Floater
description: Beat your defender into the lane and float the ball over the help defender before you reach the rim.
game: 2021 Eastern Conference First Round Game 1, Hawks at Knicks

name: Short Hook
description: Turn your shoulder toward the basket and release a one-handed hook over the defender from inside the paint.

name: One-Leg Fadeaway
description: Plant one foot, lift the other knee to create space, and lean back into a high release.

name: Double Crossover Pull-Up
description: Cross the ball over twice to shift your defender, then stop and rise into a midrange jumper.

name: Contact Scoop Layup
description: Drive into the paint, keep the ball away from the defender, and scoop it softly toward the rim.
game: 2012 Eastern Conference Semifinals Game 5, Pacers at Heat

name: Spinning Catch Layup
description: Cut into the lane, catch the pass on the move, and spin around the defender for a quick layup.
game: 2022 Eastern Conference First Round Game 1, Nets at Celtics

name: Nutmeg Layup
description: Bounce the ball between the defender's feet, race around to recover it, and finish at the rim.

name: Dream Shake
description: Work from the post, pivot and fake a shot to get the defender up, then turn back for the finish.
game: 1995 Western Conference Finals Game 2, Rockets at Spurs

name: Baseline Scoop
description: Drive along the baseline, carry the ball under the backboard, and scoop it up on the far side.

name: Midair Hand Switch
description: Jump as if to finish with one hand, transfer the ball in the air, and lay it in with the other.

name: Four-Bounce Fadeaway
description: Dribble toward the right baseline, turn your shoulders in the air, and loft a fading jumper over the contest.
game: 2019 Eastern Conference Semifinals Game 7, 76ers at Raptors

name: Logo-Range Buzzer Beater
description: Create space with a side step well behind the arc, then launch from deep as time expires.
game: 2019 Western Conference First Round Game 5, Thunder at Trail Blazers

name: Bubble Step-Back Buzzer Beater
description: Take the inbound pass, dribble toward the left wing, and step back into a three before the horn.
game: 2020 Western Conference First Round Game 4, Clippers vs. Mavericks

name: Turnaround Buzzer Beater
description: Gather with your back partly to the hoop, turn into a fading jumper, and release over the contest.

name: One-Foot Bank Runner
description: Drive toward the side of the lane, jump off one foot, and float the ball off the glass on the move.
game: 2018 Eastern Conference Semifinals Game 3, Raptors at Cavaliers

name: One-Hand Poster Dunk
description: Drive into the paint, rise with the ball in one hand, and finish above the rim.

name: Alley-Oop Hammer
description: Cut hard to the rim, catch a lob above the basket, and slam it down with one hand.

name: Reverse Pump Dunk
description: Take off toward the far side of the rim, pull the ball back in the air, then bring it through for a reverse dunk.

name: Reverse Putback Dunk
description: Time your jump off a teammate's miss, catch the rebound in the air, and finish with a reverse dunk.
